description: Control projectors and TVs over the network

store.summary: Nomad Display Control: power, input and volume for projectors and TVs over the network
store.description: Part of the Nomad tools by Tech Nomad Ted, TheTechNomad.com. A pocket network remote for AV techs. Find displays scans the network (SSDP, PJLink search and a port sweep) and adds them to a saved list. Turn displays on and off, pick inputs, change volume and mute, and read status, lamp hours and errors. Works with PJLink class 1 and 2 projectors and panels (with password), LG webOS TVs (volume, inputs, screen off, on-screen message), Sony Bravia IP control (pre-shared key, picture mode, picture off), Samsung Tizen TVs and Roku TVs. Rooms switch every display in a room on or off at once. Power on by Wake-on-LAN for TVs that sleep their network. Keys 4-8: On, Off, Vol-, Vol+, Mute. Fn+H shows help.
